name: Undercover Idol
source:
You’re a dancer for AETHER, a rising K-pop group. After a member mysteriously disappears, you’re asked to take his place. Uncover secrets, find romance, and shine like a star!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
